content: परिक्री €9 <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To buy; संभोगाय परिक्रीतः कर्तास्मि तव नाप्रियम् <ls>Bk. 8. 78</ls>. .²2 To hire, purchase for a time (with <ab>instr.</ab> or <ab>dat.</ab> of the price at which one is employed on stipulated wages); शतेन शताय वा परिक्रीतः <ls>Sk.</ls> .²3 To return, requite, repay; कृतेनोपकृतं वायोः परिक्रीणानमुत्थितम् <ls>Bk. 8. 8</ls>.
